title: June in Servo: real world compat, media queries, SharedWorker, and more! - Servo aims to empower developers with a lightweight, high-performance alternative for embedding web technologies in applications.
excerpt: We now have a new way for you to help us write the monthly updates :)
content_html:
Servo 0.4.0 contains all of the changes we landed in June, which came out to yet another record 558 commits (April: 534, May: 391). For security fixes, see § Security.

We’ve shipped several new web platform features:

  • ‘attr()’, in experimental mode (@Loirooriol, #45041)
  • ‘image(<color>)’, ‘closest-corner’, and ‘farthest-corner’ in ‘ellipse()’ and ‘circle()’ (@Loirooriol, #45421)
  • ‘calc()’ and other mathematical expressions can now be resolved later than parse time, e.g. sign(1em - 32px) (@Loirooriol, #45421)
  • ‘font-feature-settings’ in ‘@font-face’ (@simonwuelker, #45393)
  • ‘@media (device-width)’, ‘@media (device-height)’, ‘@media (height)’, ‘@media (aspect-ratio)’, and their min- and max- variants (@jdm, @mrobinson, @nicoburns, @jschwe, #44978, #45707, #45490)
  • ‘@media (orientation)’ (@nicoburns, #45707)
  • ‘@media (pointer)’ and ‘@media (any-pointer)’ (@nicoburns, #45681)
  • ‘@media (hover)’ and ‘@media (any-hover)’ (@nicoburns, #45681)

Plus a bunch of new DOM APIs:

  • Shared­Worker (@Taym95, #45786)
  • console­.dir() (@Taym95, #45109)
  • custom­Element­Registry on Document and Shadow­Root (@shubhamg13, #45872)
  • initialize() on Custom­Element­Registry (@shubhamg13, @yezhizhen, #45903)
  • new Custom­Element­Registry() (@shubhamg13, #45791, #45550)
  • text­Stream() on Request, Response, and Blob (@yezhizhen, #45864, #45861)
  • set­Pointer­Capture(), release­Pointer­Capture(), has­Pointer­Capture() on Element (@webbeef, #45048)
  • on­touch­start, on­touch­end, on­touch­move, on­touch­cancel on Element (@stevennovaryo, #45049)
  • crypto­.subtle­.digest() for KT128 and KT256 (@kkoyung, #45699)
  • crypto­.subtle­.get­Public­Key() for ML-KEM and ML-DSA (@kkoyung, #45252)

This is another big update, so here’s an outline:

  • You can help!

  • Security

  • Real world compat

  • Work in progress

  • Embedding API

  • For users and developers

  • More on the web platform

  • Garbage collection safety

  • Performance and stability

  • New contributors

You can help!

Servo is steadily becoming a bigger and busier project every month, and by June 2026, we’ve been reading through over four times the commits as we did when we started in September 2023.

This is hard work, particularly since there are things we need to know that are often difficult to answer just by reading the changes:

  • Who does the change affect, if anyone? Does it affect users, Servo developers, embedders, or some other group?

  • What observable difference does the change make, if any?

  • Does the feature require any preferences to be enabled, or is it enabled for everyone by default?

  • Are any real-world websites affected by the change?

  • What issue or broader project is the change related to? This question is answered by Fixes: #xxxxx or Part of: #xxxxx in the PR description.

Thanks to an initiative by @jdm, it’s now easier than ever for you to help us answer those questions, using the Servo Highfive bot! If you’re working on a pull request that you think might be interesting for the next monthly update, even if you’re not 100% sure, tell us about it by following the steps below:

  1. You add the monthly update label to your pull request, or comment @servo-highfive monthly update

  2. Highfive posts a comment asking you some questions

  3. You answer those questions in a comment containing @servo-highfive monthly update answer

Security

Servo’s JS runtime, SpiderMonkey 140.10.1, had several security bugs that have been fixed in Servo 0.4.0 with the update to SpiderMonkey 140.11.0 (@jschwe, #45584). For more details, see CVE-2026-8388, CVE-2026-8391, CVE-2026-8974, CVE-2026-8975, and MFSA 2026-48.

Several more security bugs in Servo’s JS runtime have been fixed in Servo 0.4.0 with the update to SpiderMonkey 140.12.0 (@jschwe, #45766). The exact CVEs that apply to us are not yet known, but for more details, see MFSA 2026-58.

RSA operations in Subtle­Crypto now do modular exponentiation in constant time (@kkoyung, #45631). Please note that our RSA implementation is currently vulnerable to the Marvin Attack – for more details, see RUSTSEC-2023-0071.

ML-DSA operations in Subtle­Crypto now do the Decompose step in constant time, fixing RUSTSEC-2025-0144 (@kkoyung, #45294).

We’ve fixed an HTML injection bug (XSS) in file:/// directory listings, which affected file names containing </script> (@sahvx655-wq, #45510).

Real world compat

Layout correctness has significantly improved on lichess.org, and many websites have become a lot more readable thanks to our improved handling of variable fonts (@simonwuelker, #45768), including Zulip (servo.zulipchat.com) and Speedtest (speedtest.net).

Many websites worked in Servo even before version 0.4.0, including Google Photos (photos.google.com) and Cash Converters (cashconverters.com.au), and continue to work in version 0.4.0. Other websites, like Google Maps (maps.google.com) and OpenStreetMap (www.openstreetmap.org), render well but have some issues with interactivity.

We’re interested to hear how well your favourite websites run in Servo! Report successes in this Zulip thread, and failures in our GitHub issues.

Work in progress

We’re implementing the more powerful version of ‘attr()’ that can be used anywhere, not just in ‘content’, under --pref layout­_css­_attr­_enabled (@Loirooriol, #45041, #45421, #45495, #45752).

WebGPU support has improved, under --pref dom­_webgpu­_enabled:

  • implemented copy­External­Image­To­Texture() on GPU­Queue (@sagudev, #45646)
  • implemented create­Query­Set() on GPU­Device and resolve­Query­Set() on GPU­Command­Encoder (@sagudev, #45644)
  • implemented push­Debug­Group(), pop­Debug­Group(), and insert­Debug­Marker() on GPU­Command­Encoder, GPU­Compute­Pass­Encoder, and GPU­Render­Pass­Encoder (@jschwe, #45489)
  • more conformant GPU­Texture (@sagudev, #45300)
  • more conformant request­Adapter() on GPU (@sagudev, #45424)
  • more conformant secure context enforcement (@sagudev, #45279)

All of the features above are enabled in servoshell’s experimental mode.

We’ve made more progress towards accessibility support, under --pref accessibility_enabled (@alice, @delan, #45555, #45554, #44949).

We’ve started implementing visible and interactive text selection (@mrobinson, @SimonSapin, #46107), one of the most long-awaited features of any web browser. Stay tuned!

We’ve also started working on Web Animations, under --pref dom­_web­_animations­_enabled (@simonwuelker, #45522, #45983), as well as webkit­Relative­Path on File, under --pref dom­_entries­_api­_enabled (@yezhizhen, #45666).

Rust doesn’t have a stable ABI, so it has generally not been possible to embed Servo in another application without building Servo from source. To make it possible, we’ve started designing a wrapper C API that will let you consume Servo as a prebuilt shared library using the stable and ubiquitous C ABI (@mukilan, #44984). Eventually the idea is that we’ll create a wrapper Rust API around that wrapper C API, so you can have both the ergonomics of Rust and the build simplicity of C.

Embedding API

New in the Servo API:

  • Web­View::rendering­_context (@mrobinson, #46047)

Breaking changes:

  • Web­View::send­_error has been removed (@mukilan, #45502) – this method was always meant to be internal, and has become unused after we introduced the new Web­View- and Web­View­Delegate-based API

We’ve improved the docs for Web­View, Web­View­Delegate, JS­Value, Alert­Dialog, Allow­Or­Deny­Request, Authentication­Response, Bluetooth­Device­Description, Confirm­Dialog, Console­Log­Level, Create­New­Web­View­Request, Embedder­Control, Embedder­Control­Response, File­Picker, Image, Java­Script­Error­Info, Navigation­Request, Permission­Request, Pixel­Format, Prompt­Dialog, Protocol­Handler­Registration, Protocol­Handler­Update­Registration, Scroll, Select­Element, Select­Element­Request, and Web­View­Vector (@mukilan, #45282, #45467).

For users and developers

In servoshell:

  • the Android version now requires Android 13+ (@jschwe, #46104)

  • the desktop version now lets you drag and drop files to open them (@simonwuelker, #45454)

  • the desktop version now lets the tab bar scroll horizontally if you have too many tabs open, but from one tab hoarder to another, maybe you should reconsider having so many tabs open (@Nylme, #44884)

  • the desktop version enters fullscreen on the monitor containing the window, even if you’ve moved it to a different monitor (@rhit-kapilaar, #45556)

  • the desktop UI is more performant, resizes more smoothly, and no longer gets stuck in hovered states (@mrobinson, #45289, #45456, #45290)

  • <select multiple> should now be interactable on all desktop platforms (@alexcat3, #45419)

  • localhost:<port> now implies http:// in the location bar and on the command line, rather than treating localhost: as an unsupported URL scheme (@SteveSharonSam, #45729, #45832)

When using the Firefox DevTools:

  • in the Console tab, uncaught exceptions are reported correctly (@jdm, #45549)

  • in the Console and Debugger tabs, you can now inspect the elements of nested arrays and the entries of Map objects (@atbrakhi, #45435, #45514, #45767)

  • in the Debugger tab, the Scopes panel now shows any ‘(uninitialized)’ variables, the value of this, and the global scope (@atbrakhi, @eerii, #45824, #45517)

We’ve fixed some build issues on riscv32, riscv64, and arm64 (@fxzjshm, @saschanaz, #45285, #45731), and modernised servoshell for Android to use Compose UI and Kotlin (@veyndan, #45923, #45932, #45941, #45982, #45985, #46015, #46035, #46037, #46046, #46053, #46061, #46071, #45641, #45643, #45650, #45665, #45671, #45676, #45679, #45683, #45712, #45713, #45734, #45738).

For developers of Servo itself:

  • mach try --help now lists all of the kinds of try jobs you can run (@shubhamg13, #45607)

  • mach test-wpt --update-expectations lets you run Web Platform Tests and update expectations in a single command (@TimvdLippe, #45521), rather than having to run mach test-wpt --log-raw <path> followed by mach update-wpt <path>

More on the web platform

To allow for more performant scrolling, ‘wheel’ events are no longer .cancelable unless there are one or more non-passive event listeners (@kunalmohan, #45667). Note that like in Firefox, ‘wheel’ events are passive by default.

‘dotted’, ‘dashed’, and ‘wavy’ text decorations are now continuous across element boundaries (@mrobinson, #45726).

We’ve improved the conformance of <dialog> (@skyz1, @mrobinson, #45825, #45761), <iframe sandbox> (@cychronex-labs, #45880), <input minlength> and <input maxlength> (@skyz1, #45705), CSS gradients (@mrobinson, #43945), ‘font-style’ and ‘unicode-range’ in ‘@font-face’ (@Loirooriol, #45821), FontFaceSet (@mrobinson, #45390, #45382), HTML­Input­Element (@steigeo, #45416), Intersection­Observer (@jdm, #45655, #45659, #45680), new Response() (@yezhizhen, #45953), URL.create­Object­URL() and URL.revoke­Object­URL() (@yezhizhen, #45182, #45417), and ECDSA and Ed25519 in Subtle­Crypto (@kkoyung, #45833, #46017).

We’ve fixed bugs related to <input hidden> (@mrobinson, #45750), ‘animation-delay’ (@yezhizhen, #45013), ‘clip-path’ (@Loirooriol, #45468, #45373), ‘tab-size’ (@SimonSapin, @mrobinson, #45309), ‘width’ and ‘height’ (@RichardTjokroutomo, #44627), ‘box-shadow: inset’ (@Loirooriol, #45620), ‘animation­iteration’ events (@Loirooriol, #45990), ‘click’ events (@mrobinson, #45751), ‘load’ events (@jdm, #45883), ‘error’ events in Worker global scopes (@Gae24, #45829), and document­.get­Element­By­Id() (@mrobinson, #45433).

Garbage collection safety

We use a RefCell-based mechanism to store many of our DOM types in other DOM types, enforcing Rust’s “aliasing xor mutability” rule at runtime by panicking if the rule is violated. But when garbage collection happens, we need to borrow() each DomRefCell to trace the references, and this is the source of many panic bugs. To fix that whole class of bugs, we initially created CanGc, a marker type that would annotate the code paths where GC can occur, in conjunction with custom static analysis (@jdm, #33140).

With the Rust type system we can do even better, if we flip that around and require any borrow_mut() call to prove that GC can not occur by passing a NoGC marker value. We can then require that a &NoGC must be borrowed from a &JSContext (which blocks GC) and not a &mut JSContext (which allows GC), taking advantage of how Rust references work without needing any custom static analysis.

We have a large codebase that needs to be migrated in parts, so for now we’ve created the new method safe­_borrow­_mut() (@sagudev, #46050). We also need to update all of our script-related code to borrow our safe JSContext wrapper, rather than creating an owned JSContext on the spot.

This continues our long-running effort to use the Rust type system to make Servo’s integration with SpiderMonkey safer and more reliable (@Gae24, @Keerti707, @Narfinger, @TimvdLippe, @sagudev, @guptapiyush16, @ivomurrell, @kunalmohan, @skyz1, #45230, #45436, #45503, #45617, #45711, #45797, #45800, #45858, #45884, #45937, #45902, #45968, #45977, #45991, #46003, #46005, #46084, #45548, #45552, #45590, #45909, #45912, #45943, #46089, #46117, #46114, #45320, #45324, #45328, #45340, #45381, #45385, #45410, #45392, #45409, #45604, #45616, #45618, #45627, #45636, #45662, #45663, #45675, #45674, #45677, #45684, #45735, #45807, #45810, #45816, #45818, #45828, #45838, #45836, #45837, #45840, #45841, #45857, #45859, #45862, #45875, #45887, #45931, #45964, #45935, #45987, #45988, #46001, #46040, #46051, #46057, #46106, #46125, #45678, #46002, #45845, #45645, #45673, #45259, #45817, #45822, #45876, #45877, #45891).

Performance and stability

NoGC was designed to prevent dynamic borrow failures, but it also enables some performance optimisations! If we can prove that garbage collection is impossible in some part of Servo, we can often avoid rooting JavaScript objects when interacting with them within that region of code. This has allowed us to reduce overheads by over 1% in the layout process and in HTML­Collection (@Narfinger, #46092, #45582).

Our memory usage has improved, with BoxFragment now 17% smaller (288 → 240 bytes on amd64) and ShapeCacheEntry now smaller too (@SimonSapin, @mrobinson, @simonwuelker, #45183, #45496).

We’ve fixed some nasty memory leaks when reloading and in 2D canvases (@Taym95, @sagudev, @jschwe, #45455, #45261, #45414).

Speaking of which, 2D canvases now use up to 23% less power (@yezhizhen, #45301), and we now avoid rasterising the same SVG more than once (@Narfinger, @jschwe, #44805).

Servo now decodes all images asynchronously and fills image caches asynchronously, leaving script threads (web content processes) more time for other work (@Narfinger, #45542, #44483). On top of that, we’ve improved incremental layout (@mrobinson, @Loirooriol, #45411) and reduced reflows in IntersectionObserver (@jschwe, #45986).

We’ve started working on incremental updates for the stacking context tree, and as a side effect, we’ve made some layout-bound microbenchmarks up to 10% faster (@mrobinson, @Loirooriol, #45208).

We’ve also reduced allocations, copies, GC rooting steps, and other operations in many parts of Servo (@Narfinger, @SimonSapin, @mrobinson, @Loirooriol, #45506, #45969, #45940, #45760, #46090, #45335, #45413, #45511).

For several months, Frédéric (@fred-wang) has been fuzzing for Servo bugs, and thanks to his work we’ve fixed sixteen (16) crash bugs in June, affecting <iframe>, <slot>, <link onerror>, ‘animation’, ‘clip-path’, ‘content’, ‘rotate’, ‘transition’, ‘transform-style’, ‘display: contents’, ‘overflow: clip’, CSS­Keyframes­Rule, Font­Face, stop() on Window, document­.element­From­Point(), and the DOM tree (@mrobinson, @Loirooriol, @fred-wang, #46031, #46027, #46054, #46058, #46016, #46028, #46033, #45287, #45951, #45634, #45629, #46110, #46094, #45799, #45611, #45682, #45788, #45612, #45834).

We’ve also fixed crash bugs related to IPC failures, HTML­Input­Element, Range, the DevTools Debugger tab, and when servoshell is built with --features native-bluetooth (@jschwe, @Taym95, @mrobinson, @atbrakhi, @mukilan, #45311, #45619, #45765, #45513, #45702).

New contributors

A special thanks to the following people for landing their first patch in Servo:

  • Deepam Goyal (@Deepam02, #44836)
  • Mark (@Mark-Boger, #45486)
  • Mr SheerLuck (@MrSheerluck, #45557)
  • Psychpsyo (Cameron) (@Psychpsyo, #45494)
  • TusharSariya (@TusharSariya, #43663)
  • Adam Sharif (@adamsharifc, #45551)
  • Akash Ravikumar (@ak4shravikumar, #45736)
  • Sean Cunneen (@alexcat3, #45419)
  • Abdul Wahab Melethil Shibu (@cychronex-labs, #45880)
  • darkdragon-001 (@darkdragon-001, #45267)
  • Frédéric Wang Nélar (@fred-wang, #45834)
  • fxzjshm (@fxzjshm, #45285)
  • Piyush Gupta (@guptapiyush16, #45845)
  • Ivo Murrell (@ivomurrell, #45645)
  • rhit-kapilaar (@rhit-kapilaar, #45556)
  • sahvx655-wq (@sahvx655-wq, #45510)
  • Kagami Sascha Rosylight (@saschanaz, #45731)
  • shangguanmachine-dot (@shangguanmachine-dot, #45310)
  • Glenn Skrzypczak (@skyz1, #45471)
  • Oskar Steiger (@steigeo, #45416)
  • Veyndan Stuart (@veyndan, #45326)

Interested in helping build a web browser? Take a look at our curated list of issues that are good for new contributors!

Donations

Thanks again for your generous support! We are now receiving 7681 USD/month (+0.2% from May) in recurring donations. This helps us cover the cost of our speedy CI and benchmarking servers, one of our latest Outreachy interns, and funding maintainer work that helps more people contribute to Servo.

Servo is also on thanks.dev, and already 35 GitHub users (same as May) that depend on Servo are sponsoring us there. If you use Servo libraries like url, html5ever, selectors, or cssparser, signing up for thanks.dev could be a good way for you (or your employer) to give back to the community.

We now have sponsorship tiers that allow you or your organisation to donate to the Servo project with public acknowlegement of your support. If you’re interested in this kind of sponsorship, please contact us at [email protected].

Use of donations is decided transparently via the Technical Steering Committee’s public funding request process, and active proposals are tracked in servo/project#187. For more details, head to our Sponsorship page.

Embedding API New in the Servo API: Web­View::rendering­_context (@mrobinson, #46047) Breaking changes: Web­View::send­_error has been removed (@mukilan, #45502) – this method was always meant to be internal, and has become unused after we introduced the new Web­View- and Web­View­Delegate-based API We’ve improved the docs for Web­View, Web­View­Delegate, JS­Value, Alert­Dialog, Allow­Or­Deny­Request, Authentication­Response, Bluetooth­Device­Description, Confirm­Dialog, Console­Log­Level, Create­New­Web­View­Request, Embedder­Control, Embedder­Control­Response, File­Picker, Image, Java­Script­Error­Info, Navigation­Request, Permission­Request, Pixel­Format, Prompt­Dialog, Protocol­Handler­Registration, Protocol­Handler­Update­Registration, Scroll, Select­Element, Select­Element­Request, and Web­View­Vector (@mukilan, #45282, #45467). For users and developers In servoshell: the Android version now requires Android 13+ (@jschwe, #46104) the desktop version now lets you drag and drop files to open them (@simonwuelker, #45454) the desktop version now lets the tab bar scroll horizontally if you have too many tabs open, but from one tab hoarder to another, maybe you should reconsider having so many tabs open (@Nylme, #44884) the desktop version enters fullscreen on the monitor containing the window, even if you’ve moved it to a different monitor (@rhit-kapilaar, #45556) the desktop UI is more performant, resizes more smoothly, and no longer gets stuck in hovered states (@mrobinson, #45289, #45456, #45290) <select multiple> should now be interactable on all desktop platforms (@alexcat3, #45419) localhost:<port> now implies http:// in the location bar and on the command line, rather than treating localhost: as an unsupported URL scheme (@SteveSharonSam, #45729, #45832) When using the Firefox DevTools: in the Console tab, uncaught exceptions are reported correctly (@jdm, #45549) in the Console and Debugger tabs, you can now inspect the elements of nested arrays and the entries of Map objects (@atbrakhi, #45435, #45514, #45767) in the Debugger tab, the Scopes panel now shows any ‘(uninitialized)’ variables, the value of this, and the global scope (@atbrakhi, @eerii, #45824, #45517) We’ve fixed some build issues on riscv32, riscv64, and arm64 (@fxzjshm, @saschanaz, #45285, #45731), and modernised servoshell for Android to use Compose UI and Kotlin (@veyndan, #45923, #45932, #45941, #45982, #45985, #46015, #46035, #46037, #46046, #46053, #46061, #46071, #45641, #45643, #45650, #45665, #45671, #45676, #45679, #45683, #45712, #45713, #45734, #45738). For developers of Servo itself: mach try --help now lists all of the kinds of try jobs you can run (@shubhamg13, #45607) mach test-wpt --update-expectations lets you run Web Platform Tests and update expectations in a single command (@TimvdLippe, #45521), rather than having to run mach test-wpt --log-raw <path> followed by mach update-wpt <path> More on the web platform To allow for more performant scrolling, ‘wheel’ events are no longer .cancelable unless there are one or more non-passive event listeners (@kunalmohan, #45667). Note that like in Firefox, ‘wheel’ events are passive by default. ‘dotted’, ‘dashed’, and ‘wavy’ text decorations are now continuous across element boundaries (@mrobinson, #45726). We’ve improved the conformance of <dialog> (@skyz1, @mrobinson, #45825, #45761), <iframe sandbox> (@cychronex-labs, #45880), <input minlength> and <input maxlength> (@skyz1, #45705), CSS gradients (@mrobinson, #43945), ‘font-style’ and ‘unicode-range’ in ‘@font-face’ (@Loirooriol, #45821), FontFaceSet (@mrobinson, #45390, #45382), HTML­Input­Element (@steigeo, #45416), Intersection­Observer (@jdm, #45655, #45659, #45680), new Response() (@yezhizhen, #45953), URL.create­Object­URL() and URL.revoke­Object­URL() (@yezhizhen, #45182, #45417), and ECDSA and Ed25519 in Subtle­Crypto (@kkoyung, #45833, #46017). We’ve fixed bugs related to <input hidden> (@mrobinson, #45750), ‘animation-delay’ (@yezhizhen, #45013), ‘clip-path’ (@Loirooriol, #45468, #45373), ‘tab-size’ (@SimonSapin, @mrobinson, #45309), ‘width’ and ‘height’ (@RichardTjokroutomo, #44627), ‘box-shadow: inset’ (@Loirooriol, #45620), ‘animation­iteration’ events (@Loirooriol, #45990), ‘click’ events (@mrobinson, #45751), ‘load’ events (@jdm, #45883), ‘error’ events in Worker global scopes (@Gae24, #45829), and document­.get­Element­By­Id() (@mrobinson, #45433). Garbage collection safety We use a RefCell-based mechanism to store many of our DOM types in other DOM types, enforcing Rust’s “aliasing xor mutability” rule at runtime by panicking if the rule is violated. But when garbage collection happens, we need to borrow() each DomRefCell to trace the references, and this is the source of many panic bugs. To fix that whole class of bugs, we initially created CanGc, a marker type that would annotate the code paths where GC can occur, in conjunction with custom static analysis (@jdm, #33140). With the Rust type system we can do even better, if we flip that around and require any borrow_mut() call to prove that GC can not occur by passing a NoGC marker value. We can then require that a &NoGC must be borrowed from a &JSContext (which blocks GC) and not a &mut JSContext (which allows GC), taking advantage of how Rust references work without needing any custom static analysis. We have a large codebase that needs to be migrated in parts, so for now we’ve created the new method safe­_borrow­_mut() (@sagudev, #46050). We also need to update all of our script-related code to borrow our safe JSContext wrapper, rather than creating an owned JSContext on the spot. This continues our long-running effort to use the Rust type system to make Servo’s integration with SpiderMonkey safer and more reliable (@Gae24, @Keerti707, @Narfinger, @TimvdLippe, @sagudev, @guptapiyush16, @ivomurrell, @kunalmohan, @skyz1, #45230, #45436, #45503, #45617, #45711, #45797, #45800, #45858, #45884, #45937, #45902, #45968, #45977, #45991, #46003, #46005, #46084, #45548, #45552, #45590, #45909, #45912, #45943, #46089, #46117, #46114, #45320, #45324, #45328, #45340, #45381, #45385, #45410, #45392, #45409, #45604, #45616, #45618, #45627, #45636, #45662, #45663, #45675, #45674, #45677, #45684, #45735, #45807, #45810, #45816, #45818, #45828, #45838, #45836, #45837, #45840, #45841, #45857, #45859, #45862, #45875, #45887, #45931, #45964, #45935, #45987, #45988, #46001, #46040, #46051, #46057, #46106, #46125, #45678, #46002, #45845, #45645, #45673, #45259, #45817, #45822, #45876, #45877, #45891). Performance and stability NoGC was designed to prevent dynamic borrow failures, but it also enables some performance optimisations! If we can prove that garbage collection is impossible in some part of Servo, we can often avoid rooting JavaScript objects when interacting with them within that region of code. This has allowed us to reduce overheads by over 1% in the layout process and in HTML­Collection (@Narfinger, #46092, #45582). Our memory usage has improved, with BoxFragment now 17% smaller (288 → 240 bytes on amd64) and ShapeCacheEntry now smaller too (@SimonSapin, @mrobinson, @simonwuelker, #45183, #45496). We’ve fixed some nasty memory leaks when reloading and in 2D canvases (@Taym95, @sagudev, @jschwe, #45455, #45261, #45414). Speaking of which, 2D canvases now use up to 23% less power (@yezhizhen, #45301), and we now avoid rasterising the same SVG more than once (@Narfinger, @jschwe, #44805). Servo now decodes all images asynchronously and fills image caches asynchronously, leaving script threads (web content processes) more time for other work (@Narfinger, #45542, #44483). On top of that, we’ve improved incremental layout (@mrobinson, @Loirooriol, #45411) and reduced reflows in IntersectionObserver (@jschwe, #45986). We’ve started working on incremental updates for the stacking context tree, and as a side effect, we’ve made some layout-bound microbenchmarks up to 10% faster (@mrobinson, @Loirooriol, #45208). We’ve also reduced allocations, copies, GC rooting steps, and other operations in many parts of Servo (@Narfinger, @SimonSapin, @mrobinson, @Loirooriol, #45506, #45969, #45940, #45760, #46090, #45335, #45413, #45511). For several months, Frédéric (@fred-wang) has been fuzzing for Servo bugs, and thanks to his work we’ve fixed sixteen (16) crash bugs in June, affecting <iframe>, <slot>, <link onerror>, ‘animation’, ‘clip-path’, ‘content’, ‘rotate’, ‘transition’, ‘transform-style’, ‘display: contents’, ‘overflow: clip’, CSS­Keyframes­Rule, Font­Face, stop() on Window, document­.element­From­Point(), and the DOM tree (@mrobinson, @Loirooriol, @fred-wang, #46031, #46027, #46054, #46058, #46016, #46028, #46033, #45287, #45951, #45634, #45629, #46110, #46094, #45799, #45611, #45682, #45788, #45612, #45834). We’ve also fixed crash bugs related to IPC failures, HTML­Input­Element, Range, the DevTools Debugger tab, and when servoshell is built with --features native-bluetooth (@jschwe, @Taym95, @mrobinson, @atbrakhi, @mukilan, #45311, #45619, #45765, #45513, #45702). blocks.html_en: Rust doesn’t have a stable ABI, so it has generally not been possible to embed Servo in another application without building Servo from source. To make it possible, we’ve started designing a wrapper C API that will let you consume Servo as a prebuilt shared library using the stable and ubiquitous C ABI (@mukilan, #44984). Eventually the idea is that we’ll create a wrapper Rust API around that wrapper C API, so you can have both the ergonomics of Rust and the build simplicity of C.

sentences.en: Garbage collection safety
sentences.zh: 垃圾收集安全

blocks.html_en: We use a RefCell-based mechanism to store many of our DOM types in other DOM types, enforcing Rust’s “aliasing xor mutability” rule at runtime by panicking if the rule is violated. But when garbage collection happens, we need to borrow() each DomRefCell to trace the references, and this is the source of many panic bugs. To fix that whole class of bugs, we initially created CanGc, a marker type that would annotate the code paths where GC can occur, in conjunction with custom static analysis (@jdm, #33140).

sentences.en: We use a RefCell-based mechanism to store many of our DOM types in other DOM types, enforcing Rust’s “aliasing xor mutability” rule at runtime by panicking if the rule is violated.
sentences.zh: 我们使用基于 RefCell 的机制将许多 DOM 类型存储在其他 DOM 类型中，在运行时强制执行 Rust 的“别名异或可变性”规则，如果违反规则就会发生恐慌。

sentences.en: But when garbage collection happens, we need to borrow() each DomRefCell to trace the references, and this is the source of many panic bugs.
sentences.zh: 但是当垃圾回收发生时，我们需要借用（）每个DomRefCell来跟踪引用，这就是许多恐慌错误的根源。

sentences.en: To fix that whole class of bugs, we initially created CanGc, a marker type that would annotate the code paths where GC can occur, in conjunction with custom static analysis (@jdm, #33140).
sentences.zh: 为了修复整类错误，我们最初创建了 CanGc，这是一种标记类型，可以结合自定义静态分析来注释可能发生 GC 的代码路径（@jdm，#33140）。

blocks.html_en: With the Rust type system we can do even better, if we flip that around and require any borrow_mut() call to prove that GC can not occur by passing a NoGC marker value. We can then require that a &NoGC must be borrowed from a &JSContext (which blocks GC) and not a &mut JSContext (which allows GC), taking advantage of how Rust references work without needing any custom static analysis.

sentences.en: With the Rust type system we can do even better, if we flip that around and require any borrow_mut() call to prove that GC can not occur by passing a NoGC marker value.
sentences.zh: 使用 Rust 类型系统，我们可以做得更好，如果我们翻转这一点并要求任何borrow_mut() 调用来证明通过传递 NoGC 标记值来证明 GC 不会发生。

sentences.en: We can then require that a &NoGC must be borrowed from a &JSContext (which blocks GC) and not a &mut JSContext (which allows GC), taking advantage of how Rust references work without needing any custom static analysis.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们可以要求必须从 &JSContext（阻止 GC）而不是 &mut JSContext（允许 GC）借用 &NoGC，利用 Rust 引用的工作方式，而不需要任何自定义静态分析。

blocks.html_en: We have a large codebase that needs to be migrated in parts, so for now we’ve created the new method safe­_borrow­_mut() (@sagudev, #46050). We also need to update all of our script-related code to borrow our safe JSContext wrapper, rather than creating an owned JSContext on the spot.

sentences.en: Performance and stability
sentences.zh: 性能稳定

blocks.html_en: NoGC was designed to prevent dynamic borrow failures, but it also enables some performance optimisations! If we can prove that garbage collection is impossible in some part of Servo, we can often avoid rooting JavaScript objects when interacting with them within that region of code. This has allowed us to reduce overheads by over 1% in the layout process and in HTML­Collection (@Narfinger, #46092, #45582).

sentences.en: NoGC was designed to prevent dynamic borrow failures, but it also enables some performance optimisations!
sentences.zh: NoGC 旨在防止动态借用失败，但它也可以实现一些性能优化！

sentences.en: If we can prove that garbage collection is impossible in some part of Servo, we can often avoid rooting JavaScript objects when interacting with them within that region of code.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能够证明垃圾回收在 Servo 的某些部分是不可能的，那么在该代码区域内与 JavaScript 对象交互时，我们通常可以避免 root。

sentences.en: This has allowed us to reduce overheads by over 1% in the layout process and in HTML­Collection (@Narfinger, #46092, #45582).

blocks.html_en: Our memory usage has improved, with BoxFragment now 17% smaller (288 → 240 bytes on amd64) and ShapeCacheEntry now smaller too (@SimonSapin, @mrobinson, @simonwuelker, #45183, #45496).

sentences.en: Our memory usage has improved, with BoxFragment now 17% smaller (288 → 240 bytes on amd64) and ShapeCacheEntry now smaller too (@SimonSapin, @mrobinson, @simonwuelker, #45183, #45496).
sentences.zh: 我们的内存使用量有所改善，BoxFragment 现在缩小了 17%（在 amd64 上为 288 → 240 字节），ShapeCacheEntry 现在也更小了（@SimonSapin、@mrobinson、@simonwuelker、#45183、#45496）。

blocks.html_en: We’ve fixed some nasty memory leaks when reloading and in 2D canvases (@Taym95, @sagudev, @jschwe, #45455, #45261, #45414).

sentences.zh: 我们修复了重新加载时和 2D 画布中的一些严重的内存泄漏（@Taym95、@sagudev、@jschwe、#45455、#45261、#45414）。

blocks.html_en: Speaking of which, 2D canvases now use up to 23% less power (@yezhizhen, #45301), and we now avoid rasterising the same SVG more than once (@Narfinger, @jschwe, #44805).

sentences.en: Speaking of which, 2D canvases now use up to 23% less power (@yezhizhen, #45301), and we now avoid rasterising the same SVG more than once (@Narfinger, @jschwe, #44805).
sentences.zh: 说到这里，2D 画布现在消耗的电量减少了 23% (@yezhizhen, #45301)，而且我们现在避免多次光栅化相同的 SVG (@Narfinger, @jschwe, #44805)。

blocks.html_en: Servo now decodes all images asynchronously and fills image caches asynchronously, leaving script threads (web content processes) more time for other work (@Narfinger, #45542, #44483). On top of that, we’ve improved incremental layout (@mrobinson, @Loirooriol, #45411) and reduced reflows in IntersectionObserver (@jschwe, #45986).

sentences.en: Servo now decodes all images asynchronously and fills image caches asynchronously, leaving script threads (web content processes) more time for other work (@Narfinger, #45542, #44483).
sentences.zh: Servo 现在异步解码所有图像并异步填充图像缓存，为脚本线程（Web 内容处理）留下更多时间用于其他工作（@Narfinger，#45542，#44483）。

sentences.en: On top of that, we’ve improved incremental layout (@mrobinson, @Loirooriol, #45411) and reduced reflows in IntersectionObserver (@jschwe, #45986).
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，我们改进了增量布局（@mrobinson、@Loirooriol、#45411）并减少了 IntersectionObserver 中的回流（@jschwe、#45986）。

blocks.html_en: We’ve started working on incremental updates for the stacking context tree, and as a side effect, we’ve made some layout-bound microbenchmarks up to 10% faster (@mrobinson, @Loirooriol, #45208).

sentences.en: We’ve started working on incremental updates for the stacking context tree, and as a side effect, we’ve made some layout-bound microbenchmarks up to 10% faster (@mrobinson, @Loirooriol, #45208).
sentences.zh: 我们已经开始致力于堆栈上下文树的增量更新，作为副作用，我们将一些布局绑定的微基准测试速度提高了 10%（@mrobinson、@Loirooriol、#45208）。

blocks.html_en: We’ve also reduced allocations, copies, GC rooting steps, and other operations in many parts of Servo (@Narfinger, @SimonSapin, @mrobinson, @Loirooriol, #45506, #45969, #45940, #45760, #46090, #45335, #45413, #45511).

sentences.en: We’ve also reduced allocations, copies, GC rooting steps, and other operations in many parts of Servo (@Narfinger, @SimonSapin, @mrobinson, @Loirooriol, #45506, #45969, #45940, #45760, #46090, #45335, #45413, #45511).
sentences.zh: 我们还减少了 Servo 许多部分的分配、副本、GC root 步骤和其他操作（@Narfinger、@SimonSapin、@mrobinson、@Loirooriol、#45506、#45969、#45940、#45760、#46090、#45335、#45413、#45511）。

content_html_zh:
Servo 0.4.0 包含我们在 6 月份进行的所有更改，这又创下了 558 次提交的记录（4 月：534，5 月：391）。 有关安全修复，请参阅§安全性。

我们推出了多项新的网络平台功能：

  • ‘attr()’，处于实验模式（@Loirooriol，#45041）
  • “ellipse()”和“circle()”中的“image(<color>)”、“最近角”和“最远角”（@Loirooriol，#45421）
  • “calc()”和其他数学表达式现在可以晚于解析时间来解析，例如标志（1em - 32px）（@Loirooriol，#45421）
  • “@font-face”中的“字体功能设置”（@simonwuelker，#45393）
  • ‘@media (device-width)’、‘@media (device-height)’、‘@media (height)’、‘@media (aspect-ratio)’及其最小和最大变体（@jdm、@mrobinson、@nicoburns、@jschwe、#44978、#45707、#45490）
  • “@media（方向）”（@nicoburns，#45707）
  • ‘@media（指针）’和‘@media（任意指针）’（@nicoburns，#45681）
  • “@media（悬停）”和“@media（任意悬停）”（@nicoburns，#45681）

加上一堆新的 DOM API：

  • SharedWorker（@Taym95，#45786）
  • console.dir() （@Taym95，#45109）
  • Document 和 ShadowRoot 上的 customElementRegistry（@shubhamg13，#45872）
  • CustomElementRegistry 上的initialize()（@shubhamg13、@yezhizhen、#45903）
  • 新的 CustomElementRegistry() （@shubhamg13、#45791、#45550）
  • 请求、响应和 Blob 上的 textStream()（@yezhizhen，#45864，#45861）
  • 元素上的 setPointerCapture()、releasePointerCapture()、hasPointerCapture()（@webbeef，#45048）
  • 元素上的 ontouchstart、ontouchend、ontouchmove、ontouchcancel（@stevennovaryo，#45049）
  • crypto.subtle.digest() 适用于 KT128 和 KT256（@kkoyung，#45699）
  • crypto.subtle.getPublicKey() 用于 ML-KEM 和 ML-DSA（@kkoyung，#45252）

这是另一个重大更新，因此概述如下：

  • 你可以帮忙！
  • 安全
  • 现实世界兼容
  • 工作正在进行中
  • 嵌入API
  • 对于用户和开发者
  • 更多内容请参见网络平台
  • 垃圾收集安全
  • 性能稳定
  • 新贡献者

你可以帮忙！

Servo 每个月都在稳步成为一个更大、更繁忙的项目，到 2026 年 6 月，我们阅读的提交量是 2023 年 9 月开始时的四倍多。

这是一项艰巨的工作，特别是因为我们需要知道的一些事情往往很难仅通过阅读更改来回答：

  • 如果有的话，变更会影响谁？ 它会影响用户、Servo 开发人员、嵌入者或其他群体吗？
  • 如果有的话，这种变化会带来什么明显的差异？
  • 该功能是否需要启用任何首选项，还是默认为每个人启用？
  • 现实世界中的网站是否受到此更改的影响？
  • 变更与什么问题或更广泛的项目相关？ PR 描述中的 Fixes: #xxxxx 或 Part of: #xxxxx 回答了这个问题。

感谢 @jdm 的倡议，您现在可以使用 Servo High Five 机器人比以往更轻松地帮助我们回答这些问题！ 如果您正在处理您认为下个月更新可能会感兴趣的拉取请求，即使您不是 100% 确定，也可以按照以下步骤告诉我们：

  1. 您将每月更新标签添加到拉取请求中，或评论@servo-high Five每月更新
  2. High Five 发表评论询问您一些问题
  3. 您在包含 @servo-high Five 每月更新答案的评论中回答这些问题

安全

Servo 的 JS 运行时 SpiderMonkey 140.10.1 有几个安全错误，这些错误已在 Servo 0.4.0 中通过更新 SpiderMonkey 140.11.0 得到修复（@jschwe，#45584）。 有关更多详细信息，请参阅 CVE-2026-8388、CVE-2026-8391、CVE-2026-8974、CVE-2026-8975 和 MFSA 2026-48。

Servo JS 运行时中的几个安全错误已在 Servo 0.4.0 中通过更新 SpiderMonkey 140.12.0 得到修复（@jschwe，#45766）。 适用于我们的确切 CVE 尚不清楚，但有关更多详细信息，请参阅 MFSA 2026-58。

SubtleCrypto 中的 RSA 运算现在可以在恒定时间内进行模幂运算（@kkoyung，#45631）。 请注意，我们的 RSA 实现目前容易受到 Marvin 攻击 - 有关更多详细信息，请参阅 RUSTSEC-2023-0071。

SubtleCrypto 中的 ML-DSA 操作现在以恒定时间执行分解步骤，修复 RUSTSEC-2025-0144（@kkoyung，#45294）。

我们修复了 file:/// 目录列表中的 HTML 注入错误 (XSS)，该错误影响包含 </script> 的文件名（@sahvx655-wq，#45510）。

现实世界兼容

lichess.org 上的布局正确性得到了显着改善，并且由于我们改进了对可变字体的处理（@simonwuelker，#45768），许多网站变得更具可读性，包括 Zulip (servo.zulipchat.com) 和 Speedtest (speedtest.net)。

许多网站甚至在 0.4.0 版本之前就可以在 Servo 中运行，包括 Google Photos (photos.google.com) 和 Cash Converters (cashconverters.com.au)，并且在 0.4.0 版本中继续运行。 其他网站，如 Google 地图 (maps.google.com) 和 OpenStreetMap (www.openstreetmap.org)，渲染效果良好，但在交互性方面存在一些问题。

我们很想知道您最喜欢的网站在 Servo 中的运行情况如何！ 在此 Zulip 线程中报告成功，在我们的 GitHub 问题中报告失败。

工作正在进行中

我们正在实现更强大的“attr()”版本，它可以在任何地方使用，而不仅仅是在“内容”中，在--preflayout_css_attr_enabled下（@Loirooriol，#45041，#45421，#45495，#45752）。

WebGPU 支持已改进，在 --pref dom_webgpu_enabled 下：

  • 在 GPUQueue 上实现了 copyExternalImageToTexture() (@sagudev，#45646)
  • 在 GPUDevice 上实现了 createQuerySet() 并在 GPUCommandEncoder 上实现了resolveQuerySet() (@sagudev，#45644)
  • 在 GPUCommandEncoder、GPUComputePassEncoder 和 GPURenderPassEncoder 上实现了 pushDebugGroup()、popDebugGroup() 和 insertDebugMarker()（@jschwe，#45489）
  • 自定义 GPUTexture（@sagudev，#45300）
  • GPU 上更符合 requestAdapter() (@sagudev, #45424)
  • 更一致的安全上下文实施（@sagudev，#45279）

上述所有功能均在servoshell的实验模式下启用。

我们在 --prefaccessibility_enabled 下在辅助功能支持方面取得了更多进展（@alice、@delan、#45555、#45554、#44949）。

我们已经开始实现可见的交互式文本选择（@mrobinson，@SimonSapin，#46107），这是任何网络浏览器最期待的功能之一。 敬请关注！

我们还开始在 --pref dom_web_animations_enabled (@simonwuelker, #45522, #45983) 下开发 Web 动画，以及在 --pref dom_entries_api_enabled (@yezhizhen, #45666) 下开发文件上的 webkitRelativePath。

Rust 没有稳定的 ABI，因此通常不可能在不从源代码构建 Servo 的情况下将 Servo 嵌入到另一个应用程序中。 为了实现这一点，我们开始设计一个包装 C API，让您可以使用稳定且普遍存在的 C ABI 将 Servo 作为预构建的共享库来使用（@mukilan，#44984）。 最终的想法是，我们将围绕包装器 C API 创建一个包装器 Rust API，这样您就可以同时拥有 Rust 的人体工程学和 C 的构建简单性。

嵌入API

伺服 API 中的新增功能：

  • WebView::rendering_context（@mrobinson，#46047）

重大变化：

  • WebView::send_error 已被删除（@mukilan，#45502）——此方法始终是内部方法，在我们引入新的基于 WebView 和 WebViewDelegate 的 API 后已不再使用

我们改进了 WebView、WebViewDelegate、JSValue、AlertDialog、AllowOrDenyRequest、AuthenticationResponse、BluetoothDeviceDescription、ConfirmDialog、ConsoleLogLevel、CreateNewWebViewRequest、EmbedderControl、EmbedderControlResponse、FilePicker、Image、JavaScriptErrorInfo、NavigationRequest、PermissionRequest、PixelFormat、PromptDialog、ProtocolHandlerRegistration、ProtocolHandlerUpdateRegistration、Scroll、SelectElement、SelectElementRequest 和 WebViewVector 的文档（@mukilan，#45282，#45467）。

对于用户和开发者

在伺服外壳中：

  • Android 版本现在需要 Android 13+ (@jschwe, #46104)
  • 桌面版本现在允许您拖放文件来打开它们（@simonwuelker，#45454）
  • 如果您打开了太多选项卡，桌面版本现在可以让选项卡栏水平滚动，但从一个选项卡囤积者到另一个选项卡，也许您应该重新考虑打开这么多选项卡（@Nylme，#44884）
  • 桌面版本在包含窗口的显示器上进入全屏，即使您已将其移动到不同的显示器（@rhit-kapilaar，#45556）
  • 桌面 UI 性能更高，调整大小更顺畅，并且不再陷入悬停状态（@mrobinson，#45289，#45456，#45290）
  • <select multiple> 现在应该可以在所有桌面平台上进行交互（@alexcat3，#45419）
  • localhost:<port> 现在在地址栏和命令行中暗示 http://，而不是将 localhost: 视为不受支持的 URL 方案（@SteveSharonSam、#45729、#45832）

使用 Firefox 开发者工具时：

  • 在“控制台”选项卡中，可以正确报告未捕获的异常（@jdm，#45549）
  • 在“控制台”和“调试器”选项卡中，您现在可以检查嵌套数组的元素和 Map 对象的条目（@atbrakhi、#45435、#45514、#45767）
  • 在“调试器”选项卡中，“范围”面板现在显示任何“（未初始化）”变量、其值以及全局范围（@atbrakhi、@eerii、#45824、#45517）

我们修复了 riscv32、riscv64 和 arm64 上的一些构建问题（@fxzjshm、@saschanaz、#45285、#45731），并对 Android 的servoshell 进行了现代化，以使用 Compose UI 和 Kotlin（@veyndan、#45923、#45932、#45941、#45982、#45985、 #46015、#46035、#46037、#46046、#46053、#46061、#46071、#45641、#45643、#45650、#45665、#45671、#45676、#45679、#45683、#45712、 ＃45713，＃45734，＃45738）。

对于 Servo 本身的开发者来说：

  • mach try --help 现在列出了您可以运行的所有类型的 try 作业（@shubhamg13，#45607）
  • mach test-wpt --update-expectations 允许您在单个命令中运行 Web 平台测试并更新期望（@TimvdLippe，#45521），而不必运行 mach test-wpt --log-raw <path> 后跟 mach update-wpt <path>

更多内容请参见网络平台

为了实现更高性能的滚动，“滚轮”事件不再是可取消的，除非有一个或多个非被动事件侦听器（@kunalmohan，#45667）。 请注意，与 Firefox 一样，“wheel”事件默认是被动的。

“点”、“虚线”和“波浪”文本装饰现在在元素边界上是连续的（@mrobinson，#45726）。

我们改进了 <dialog> (@skyz1, @mrobinson, #45825, #45761)、<iframe sandbox> (@cychronex-labs, #45880)、<input minlength> 和 <input maxlength> (@skyz1, #45705)、CSS 渐变 (@mrobinson, #43945)、‘font-style’ 和“@font-face”中的“unicode-range”（@Loirooriol，#45821），FontFaceSet（@mrobinson，#45390，#45382），HTMLInputElement（@steigeo，#45416），IntersectionObserver（@jdm，#45655，#45659，#45680），new Response（）（@yezhizhen， #45953)、URL.createObjectURL() 和 URL.revokeObjectURL() (@yezhizhen, #45182, #45417) 以及 SubtleCrypto 中的 ECDSA 和 Ed25519 (@kkoyung, #45833, #46017)。

我们修复了与<input hide>（@mrobinson，#45750），“animation-delay”（@yezhizhen，#45013），“clip-path”（@Loirooriol，#45468，#45373），“tab-size”（@SimonSapin，@mrobinson，#45309），“width”和“height”相关的错误(@RichardTjokroutomo, #44627), ‘box-shadow: inset’ (@Loirooriol, #45620), ‘animationiteration’ 事件 (@Loirooriol, #45990), ‘click’ 事件 (@mrobinson, #45751), ‘load’ 事件 (@jdm, #45883), Worker 全局范围内的 ‘error’ 事件（@Gae24，#45829）和 document.getElementById()（@mrobinson，#45433）。

垃圾收集安全

我们使用基于 RefCell 的机制将许多 DOM 类型存储在其他 DOM 类型中，在运行时强制执行 Rust 的“别名异或可变性”规则，如果违反规则就会发生恐慌。 但是当垃圾回收发生时，我们需要借用（）每个DomRefCell来跟踪引用，这就是许多恐慌错误的根源。 为了修复整类错误，我们最初创建了 CanGc，这是一种标记类型，可以结合自定义静态分析来注释可能发生 GC 的代码路径（@jdm，#33140）。

使用 Rust 类型系统，我们可以做得更好，如果我们翻转这一点并要求任何borrow_mut() 调用来证明通过传递 NoGC 标记值来证明 GC 不会发生。 然后，我们可以要求必须从 &JSContext（阻止 GC）而不是 &mut JSContext（允许 GC）借用 &NoGC，利用 Rust 引用的工作方式，而不需要任何自定义静态分析。

我们有一个大型代码库需要分部分迁移，因此现在我们创建了新方法 safe_borrow_mut() (@sagudev，#46050)。 我们还需要更新所有与脚本相关的代码以借用安全的 JSContext 包装器，而不是当场创建一个拥有的 JSContext。

This continues our long-running effort to use the Rust type system to make Servo’s integration with SpiderMonkey safer and more reliable (@Gae24, @Keerti707, @Narfinger, @TimvdLippe, @sagudev, @guptapiyush16, @ivomurrell, @kunalmohan, @skyz1, #45230, #45436, #45503, #45617, #45711, #45797, #45800, #45858, #45884, #45937, #45902, #45968, #45977, #45991, #46003, #46005, #46084, #45548, #45552, #45590, #45909, #45912, #45943, #46089, #46117, #46114, #45320, #45324, #45328, #45340, #45381, #45385, #45410, #45392, #45409, #45604, #45616, #45618, #45627, #45636, #45662, #45663, #45675, #45674, #45677, #45684, #45735, #45807, #45810, #45816, #45818, #45828, #45838, #45836, #45837, #45840, #45841, #45857, #45859, #45862, #45875, #45887, #45931, #45964, #45935, #45987, #45988, #46001, #46040, #46051, #46057, #46106, #46125, #45678, #46002, #45845, #45645, #45673, #45259, #45817, #45822, #45876, #45877, #45891).

性能稳定

NoGC 旨在防止动态借用失败，但它也可以实现一些性能优化！ 如果我们能够证明垃圾回收在 Servo 的某些部分是不可能的，那么在该代码区域内与 JavaScript 对象交互时，我们通常可以避免 root。 这使我们能够在布局过程和 HTMLCollection 中减少超过 1% 的开销（@Narfinger，#46092，#45582）。

我们的内存使用量有所改善，BoxFragment 现在缩小了 17%（在 amd64 上为 288 → 240 字节），ShapeCacheEntry 现在也更小了（@SimonSapin、@mrobinson、@simonwuelker、#45183、#45496）。

我们修复了重新加载时和 2D 画布中的一些严重的内存泄漏（@Taym95、@sagudev、@jschwe、#45455、#45261、#45414）。

说到这里，2D 画布现在消耗的电量减少了 23% (@yezhizhen, #45301)，而且我们现在避免多次光栅化相同的 SVG (@Narfinger, @jschwe, #44805)。

Servo 现在异步解码所有图像并异步填充图像缓存，为脚本线程（Web 内容处理）留下更多时间用于其他工作（@Narfinger，#45542，#44483）。 最重要的是，我们改进了增量布局（@mrobinson、@Loirooriol、#45411）并减少了 IntersectionObserver 中的回流（@jschwe、#45986）。

我们已经开始致力于堆栈上下文树的增量更新，作为副作用，我们将一些布局绑定的微基准测试速度提高了 10%（@mrobinson、@Loirooriol、#45208）。

我们还减少了 Servo 许多部分的分配、副本、GC root 步骤和其他操作（@Narfinger、@SimonSapin、@mrobinson、@Loirooriol、#45506、#45969、#45940、#45760、#46090、#45335、#45413、#45511）。

几个月来，Frédéric (@fred-wang) 一直在对 Servo 错误进行模糊测试，由于他的工作，我们在 6 月修复了十六 (16) 个崩溃错误，影响了 <iframe>、<slot>、<link onerror>、‘animation’、‘clip-path’、‘content’、‘rotate’、‘transition’、‘transform-style’、‘display:contents’、‘overflow:clip’、 CSSKeyframesRule、FontFace、Window 上的 stop()、document.elementFromPoint() 和 DOM 树（@mrobinson、@Loirooriol、@fred-wang、#46031、#46027、#46054、#46058、#46016、#46028、#46033、#45287、#45951、 ＃45634，＃45629，＃46110，＃46094，＃45799，＃45611，＃45682，＃45788，＃45612，＃45834）。

我们还修复了与 IPC 故障、HTMLInputElement、Range、DevTools Debugger 选项卡以及使用 --features native-bluetooth 构建servoshell 相关的崩溃错误（@jschwe、@Taym95、@mrobinson、@atbrakhi、@mukilan、#45311、#45619、#45765、#45513、#45702）。
